verdict.rationale: Docs directly support the story: templates can be cloned and customized, build/deploy claimed under 5 minutes, voice/accent selection, phone number and telephony setup (BYOT/SIP), and a quickstart walking through key verification, agent creation, placing a call, and fetching a transcript in ~5 minutes. This covers prompt (agent config/templates), voice (voice/provider selection), and phone number (telephony/SIP) end-to-end for a first live call within an hour. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the 'under 5 minutes' or 'first call in an hour' claims beyond vendor docs, and no third-party success report.
